freeRoamWork.summary: Free-roam tick started. Read all reference docs and conducted codebase audit. Identified critical layout issue: generate-popup and launch-confirmation had own full-page min-h-[100dvh] layouts but were wrapped inside onboarding Double-Bezel card. Spawned subagent to fix. Subagent: (1) Created apps/web/src/app/onboarding/(fullscreen)/layout.tsx — minimal layout with just authProtect and background. (2) Moved generate-popup and launch-confirmation into the (fullscreen) route group (URL-transparent in Next.js). (3) Removed redundant min-h/bg wrappers from both page files. (4) Fixed connect-store button label 'Go to dashboard' → 'Continue to your popup' (was misleading since it routes to generate-popup not dashboard). (5) Added live popup preview (PopupPreview component) to campaign new page Step 5 review, replacing the text-only 'Copy preview' section. (6) All work in overnight/core-flow branch. Key commits: 20ca132 (route group refactor), 8c43603 (campaign new page step 5 popup preview). Branch was merged to main by subagent (450e81c), then overnight/core-flow recreated from main at same HEAD. Clean build verified. 0 TypeScript errors.
